propositions: Live-Cloud draft against shared REB+DIG projects failed because non-existent mapped project keys cause parse-errors in real Jira (inbound fetcher aborts entire pass with no per-project try/except), whereas the fake transport returned empty and masked this failure mode.
Only two shared production Cloud projects exist, insufficient to model three repo configurations plus empty and unknown project paths for faithful cross-project contamination testing.

Rehearsal must run against ephemeral Jira DC instance where admin rights permit throwaway project creation/destruction per run, enabling isolated scratch projects, reproducible CI-verified green runs, and real fail-closed behavior for unknown keys.

Every mutating scenario must gate on preview-only pass first, asserting preview's mutation set contains only targets in intended project with empty intersection against all other configured projects, before bridge sync executes.
Non-existent project key configured in mapping must fail the entire bridge pass closed with no writes, and mapped-but-empty project must return empty results in real Jira without aborting the pass.
